resources.string: No trophy yet: cups, Rebirth and Flame trophies are kept here.
A visitor only sees the month you won a trophy, never the exact date.
No stamp yet: write in another language.
Your Atlas is private by default: a language can say a lot about you. The game keeps the language, both directions and the date — never the other person or the conversation.
Outside accepted friends, nobody sees whether you are online or when you play.
This joust name isn’t valid: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

Together, your sparks form your light, and your level is read from it. A million sparks for level 100, and a trial every ten levels: until it is passed, your light waits. Twenty phases. Levels climb up to 499; the Ambassador rank opens them up to 1,000, and the Oracle rank opens them without limit. Each level asks for a little more than the one before.
